component.text: The Clipboard targets one patient and gathers readings from diagnostic tools. Temperature and every other completed observation are written into the same case.
Medical Reports preserve patient and exact-strain evidence. Matching reports improve vaccine research; a report from another strain must not be trusted even when the visible symptoms look alike.

CRISPR Notes store the completed 60-base program and Cas/PAM choice. Paper copies notes, while a Book and Quill receives a readable copy without opening during the transfer. Notes can be loaded as a template once all 15 cartridges are installed.
